GPTR-F-001-S7.title: Define Allowlist Enforcement Schema and Request Contract
GPTR-F-001-S7.description: Define strict request/response schema for GPTReader including allowlist fields (collection, query type, limits) and validation contract enforced via Pydantic models or equivalent schema validation.

GPTR-F-001-S8.title: Implement Core Allowlist Validation Logic
GPTR-F-001-S8.description: Build server-side validation engine that enforces strict allowlist rules for collections, fields, query operators, and result limits before executing any GPTReader request.

GPTR-F-001-S9.title: Integrate Scope Enforcement into Azure Function Endpoint
GPTR-F-001-S9.description: Embed allowlist validation into GPTReader Azure Function request lifecycle, ensuring all inbound requests are validated prior to authentication and database access execution.

GPTR-F-001-S10.title: Develop Unit and Integration Tests for Scope Enforcement
GPTR-F-001-S10.description: Create comprehensive test suite validating allowlist enforcement including positive (allowed queries) and negative (blocked queries, malformed requests, over-limit access) scenarios.

GPTR-F-001-S11.title: Integrate Scope Enforcement with Auth and Audit Pipeline
GPTR-F-001-S11.description: Ensure allowlist enforcement interoperates with bearer token authentication and existing audit logging, enforcing scope post-auth and before execution while preserving traceability.
